mechanism: Dronedarone inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase primaquine levels; both drugs carry risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias, and primaquine causes hemolysis in G6PD deficiency which may stress cardiac function.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval; baseline G6PD testing is essential before primaquine use; consider alternative antimalarial if possible; monitor for hemolytic anemia signs.
